The snake_case naming strategy moved from the DTOs onto the codec, which is what allows the JSON library to be swapped. @JsonNaming lives in Jackson's databind package, which moved in Jackson 3, so a Jackson 3 mapper cannot see it. The wire format is unchanged and covered by tests.
Added so the DTOs can also be deserialized by Jackson 3, whose databind-package @JsonDeserialize(builder=...) differs from Jackson 2's. Jackson 2 behaviour is unchanged.
Added to the builders so the Jackson 3 creator does not depend on the consuming mapper enabling field visibility.
